main.description: Supervision or mentoring of a student or junior researcher. PRIVACY: this record is about a third party, published from the supervisor's account, in a power-asymmetric relationship. The student's name MUST NOT be populated without their explicit, revocable consent; conforming clients default `student.name` to empty and require an affirmative action to set it. A DID reference is preferred, since it lets the student control their own presentation. A record with no student identity at all is still useful -- '3 doctoral students supervised' is what most CVs actually print.

student.description: Prefer DID. See the record-level privacy note before setting `name`.

status.description: 'discontinued' is recorded neutrally and carries no judgement; clients should not render it as a negative outcome.

thesisTitle.description: Equal language variants. Only with the student's consent, since a thesis title identifies them as surely as a name.

thesisRef.description: StrongRef to a pub.paper.reference for the deposited thesis. Once a thesis is publicly deposited its authorship is already public.
